title: The New York Tribune Publishes the First Application of the Linotype
version: Dated undated. Historical account referencing Carl Schlesinger and the 1886 facsimile
lineage: Historical synthesis citing Schlesinger’s inspection of a facsimile, not the primary issue or Schlesinger book independently inspected; the scope differs from the GPO whole-page account.

passages.locator: Main article, first two paragraphs and Schlesinger note
passages.note: Reports that the 3 July 1886 issue used Linotype on part of page four and describes Schlesinger’s evidence that three stories were recognizable.
